name: whatsapp
title: WhatsApp
description: Your WhatsApp chats through a self-hosted OpenWA gateway: the chats by recency with the newest message and who sent it, the unread ones at the root and counted on the bar, a full-text search over the whole archive, the contacts with their numbers. Reading and marking read are always on; sending, replying and reacting only where you turn send on.
author: pal

settings.label: OpenWA URL
settings.description: Where the OpenWA gateway answers (its /api is under it). The owner's runs at http://wp.lan; a generic install is http://localhost:3000.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: A key from OpenWA's Settings, API keys, sent as x-api-key. Kept in the OS keychain; the file holds a reference.

settings.label: Session
settings.description: The OpenWA session's name (the UUID it resolves to is cached); the one your phone is linked to.

settings.label: Send
settings.text: Send messages, reply and react from pal
settings.description: Off (the default) leaves WhatsApp read and mark-read only: no message field, no reply, no reaction, whatever the key could do. On adds Send a message and React to a chat row and the reply field to the bar popover; every send is a form you submit.

settings.label: Bar item
settings.text: Show the bar item only while a chat is unread
settings.description: Off keeps the WhatsApp glyph on the bar with no count, as a way into the popover, which then lists the recent chats.

settings.label: Direct messages
settings.text: Draw the bar item as urgent (red) while a direct chat is unread

settings.label: Open chats in
settings.description: auto opens the desktop app when it is installed (macOS) and the web client otherwise. A group has no link of its own, so it opens WhatsApp at the top either way.

options.title: The desktop app when installed, else the web client

chats.title: Chats
chats.description: Every chat, unread first then newest first, with the picture, the newest message and who sent it, the unread count, the time; the pane is the last twenty messages as a conversation.

keys.title: Open the chat (a group opens WhatsApp at the top)
Mark as read (Mark as unread on a read chat)
React to the latest message (send on)
Copy the number (the name of a group)

unread.title: Unread
unread.description: Only the chats with something unread, direct messages then groups; the same rows and keys as Chats.

keys.title: React to the latest message (send on)
Copy the number (the name of a group)

search.title: Search WhatsApp
search.description: Full-text search over the archive (every message back to the first chat): the matching line, who said it where, and when.

keys.title: Open the chat in the web client

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.description: Every saved contact with the number; open a chat, copy the number, copy a vCard.

keys.title: Open a chat with the contact
Open the chat in the web client

unread.title: Unread
unread.description: The number of unread chats as a badge, hidden at zero, red while a direct chat waits; the popover lists them with the picture, the newest message and the time, opens, marks read and (send on) replies from the keys.

keys.title: Move the cursor (down, j, k too; a click sets it)
Reply: the search row becomes the field, Enter sends (send on)
Open the row's chat in the web client

chat.description: A chat id (…@c.us, …@lid, …@g.us), a phone number, or a name from the chats or the contacts

store.tagline: Your WhatsApp chats, search and contacts in the panel
features: Chats: every conversation newest first with the unread ones on top, the profile picture, the newest message and who sent it, the unread count, the time
Enter opens the chat in the desktop app or the web client; cmd+Enter marks it read; the pane is the last twenty messages as a conversation with the quoted replies and the media named
Search WhatsApp as you type: full-text over the whole archive, the matching line with who said it where and when
Contacts: every saved contact with the number; open a chat, copy the number, copy a vCard
The bar item: the number of unread chats, hidden at zero, red while a direct chat waits; the popover opens, marks read and replies from the keys
Sending is off until you turn it on: with it, Send a message and React on a chat row, a reply field in the popover, every one a form you submit
Reads a self-hosted OpenWA gateway over its HTTP API with an API key; nothing else sees your chats

actions.title: Open chat
actions.description: In the desktop app (whatsapp://send?phone=) or the web client; a group opens WhatsApp at the top.

actions.title: Mark as read
actions.description: Mark as unread on a read chat; works on marked rows too.

actions.title: Send a message
actions.description: A form; the latest message quotable; send on only.

actions.title: React to the latest message
actions.description: One of WhatsApp's six quick reactions, or remove yours; send on only.
